note: Planning layer, superseded by days.json (which the map renders). Updated 2026-10-02 to the decided single route: 3-day Coosa Creek hike Sat Oct 17 - Mon Oct 19, waterfall day Tue Oct 20. Each stop reuses an existing point id from map/data/*.json where one exists.

days.label: Thu Oct 15 — Arrive, DeSoto Falls + Frogtown Creek, Trahlyta Falls

First panning lesson on Frogtown Creek; walk the DeSoto Falls trail from the same lot
Evening walk to Trahlyta Falls inside the park

days.label: Fri Oct 16 — Dahlonega, then stage truck 2 at Owltown Gap

stops.note: Gold Museum State Historic Site, lunch on the square first
Evening: stage truck 2 at Owltown Gap for Monday's walk-out

days.label: Sat Oct 17 — Hike day 1: Vogel to West Fork Wolf Creek (camp)

stops.note: Walk out of camp onto the Coosa Backcountry Trail. Deer season opens today — blaze orange.

stops.coord_source: approximate; real point is WOLF-X in days.json

days.label: Sun Oct 18 — Hike day 2: over Calf Stomp Gap to East Fork Coosa Creek (camp)

stops.coord_source: approximate; real point is CAMP-C in days.json
stops.note: Pan Roaring Fork confluence on the way; camp and pan at the Jones Branch confluence

days.label: Mon Oct 19 — Hike day 3: out Bowers Road to Owltown Gap, drive to Vogel

stops.note: Pan at the private-boundary stop, walk out to truck 2 at Owltown Gap
Back at base camp by mid-afternoon

days.label: Tue Oct 20 — Waterfall day: Helton Creek Falls, Tesnatee Gap, Upper Chattahoochee, Dukes Creek Falls

stops.note: Helton Creek Falls, short trail, two drops
Upper Chattahoochee / FS-44 pan, stay below Mark Trail Wilderness
Dukes Creek Falls walk + pan, NF side only

days.label: Wed Oct 21 — Break camp, depart by noon
